limitations.no_success_rate: two prescribed entries are not a statistical reliability claim and no success rate is inferred
limitations.no_assessment: no assessment action, repair, forced release, recovery, object move or Hermes call is performed
limitations.no_source_edits: this module only READS the accepted sibling modules and the read-only baseline report; it never writes, patches or re-generates them
